# Prague-CZ.com

> Prague-CZ.com is a comprehensive hotel booking and accommodation guide for visitors to Prague, Czech Republic, featuring centrally-located 3-star and 4-star hotels.

The site specializes in Prague city center accommodations, offering detailed information about hotel facilities, room types, special offers, and proximity to major attractions like Wenceslas Square and Na můstku. Each hotel listing includes booking information, amenities, and guest services to help travelers find suitable lodging in Prague.

## Key Topics

- Prague hotels
- Czech Republic accommodations
- Wenceslas Square
- City center hotels
- Hotel booking
- Room amenities
- Special offers
- Budget hotels
- Family suites
- WiFi included
- 3-star hotels
- 4-star hotels
- Prague lodging
- Na můstku

## 4-Star Hotels

- [Prague Inn](https://prague-cz.com/en/p/hotel11000inn.html): 4-star Prague Inn near Wenceslas Square with room types & booking offers
- [Union Hotel Prague](https://prague-cz.com/en/p/hotelunion.html): 4-star Union Hotel Prague budget accommodation with WiFi included
- [Unitas Hotel](https://prague-cz.com/en/p/hotelunitas.html): 4-star Unitas Hotel with suite options and Prague lodging amenities
- [Hotel Unique](https://prague-cz.com/en/p/hotelunique.html): 4-star Hotel Unique Prague with rooms, facilities & special offers

## 3-Star Hotels

- [Old Prague Hotel](https://prague-cz.com/en/p/hotelold.html): 3-star Old Prague Hotel booking info with rooms, facilities & attractions
- [Central Hotel Prague](https://prague-cz.com/en/p/hotelcentral.html): 3-star Central Hotel Prague with family suites and city center location
